name: AI & Data Analytics
headline: Turn scattered data into decisions you can see.
intro: Unified data, clear dashboards and AI-assisted insight, so leaders see what is happening across the business and understand why.

overview.what: AI and data analytics brings data from your systems into one governed foundation, models it into trusted metrics, and presents it through dashboards, reports and natural-language exploration.
overview.why: Most organisations already hold the answers in their ERP, CRM, finance and marketing tools. The problem is that the data sits in silos, reports take days to prepare and every team measures things differently.
problems: Weekly reports assembled manually from several exports
Different teams quoting different numbers for the same metric
Dashboards that look good but are slow, outdated or ignored
Questions that need an analyst's time before anyone can answer them
overview.approach: We agree the metrics that matter, consolidate data into a clean model, build dashboards for specific audiences and decisions, and add AI features that let people ask questions and spot changes without waiting for a report.

deliver.d: Pipelines from your applications, spreadsheets and APIs into a central, well-modelled store.
Interactive views for leadership, sales, finance, operations and marketing.
Agreed definitions and calculations so everyone reads the same numbers.
Scheduled reports delivered to email or chat, replacing manual preparation.
Natural-language questions, automatic summaries and alerts for unusual changes.
Access control, lineage and quality checks that keep the numbers trustworthy.

capabilities.d: Scheduled extraction, cleaning and transformation with monitoring and retry logic.
Structures designed for fast, consistent analysis across business domains.
Filters, drill-downs and ad-hoc analysis for non-technical users.
Ask a question in plain English and get a chart or table backed by governed data.
Automatic notification when a metric moves outside its expected range.
Dashboards embedded inside your own application or customer portal.

process.d: We identify the decisions you need to make and the metrics that inform them.
Systems, tables and spreadsheets are catalogued, and data quality issues are noted.
Pipelines and models are created, tested and reconciled with your known numbers.
Interfaces are designed with users, starting from the questions they ask most.
Teams are onboarded, permissions are set and adoption is tracked.
New sources, metrics and AI features are added as needs develop.

benefits.d: Shared definitions end disagreements over whose number is right.
Leaders see current performance and can act without waiting for a report.
Alerts highlight issues while there is still time to respond.
Natural-language exploration lets more people use data confidently.

usecases.d: Pipeline, win rate and regional performance in a single live dashboard.
Receivables, payables and margin trends consolidated from several systems.
Throughput, delays and stock levels tracked against targets.
Spend and conversions from all channels compared in one place.

cta.h: See your business clearly, in one place.
cta.p: Tell us which numbers you struggle to trust or find. We will propose a practical route to dashboards your team will use.
